This post-retirement assignment is initially for one year, with remuneration as per CRIS norms, and the applicant must not be more than 62 years of age on the closing date. Applications in the enclosed format go by Dak

content_sections.heading: About CRIS
content_sections.text: The Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS) is an organisation of the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, located at Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021. This vacancy notice, No. CRIS/ITPI/ESTB/951/2026-PERS (CN 10027) dated 04.11.2026, was issued over the digital signature of Anil Kumar Chaudhary, Chief Manager/Personnel. The post sits in the CIVIL project and group of CRIS.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only retired Railway Officers can apply, as the Project Officer post is a post-retirement assignment. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice prints these requirements: Railway Officers retired from the post of Junior scale or Senior scale (Pay Level-10 & above). Experience of all sorts of field activities - construction as well as maintenance in civil Engg assets - with domain knowledge of civil Engg. Experience of office working such as preparation of estimates, drawing, budget allocation, works sanction and progress monitoring activities, tendering & procurement, official correspondence etc. The official should be conversant with working in a computerized environment. The applicant must not be more than 62 years of age on the closing date (i.e. not retired more than 2 years back). The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording for the Project Officer post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: as per CRIS norms. The notice prints no amount, and pay for the retired officer is not stated beyond this line. Engagement period: initially for one year. Duty in shift: required. Holiday working, including Saturday and Sunday: required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRIS Project Officer
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application Format enclosed with the notice (page 2 of the PDF). Attach a copy of the PPO/Service and Experience certificate; the form asks for a legible copy of the PPO. Sign the form as the applicant. Send the application by Dak, or by email to [email protected] in PDF format. Make sure it is sent within 30 days from the date of publication on the CRIS website (about 4 December 2026). The notice does not print a separate postal address for applications sent by Dak; the office address printed on the notice is Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CRIS Recruitment 2026 for Project Officer?
faq.answer: There is one (1) Project Officer post in the CIVIL group at the CRIS office, New Delhi, under Vacancy Notice No. 48/2026(R) 61/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CRIS Project Officer post?
faq.answer: The closing date is 30 days from the date of publication on the CRIS website, which is about 4 December 2026 counted from the notice date of 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the CRIS Project Officer post?
faq.answer: Railway Officers retired from the post of Junior scale or Senior scale (Pay Level-10 & above) with field experience in construction and maintenance of civil engineering assets and office working experience can apply. They should be conversant with working in a computerized environment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CRIS Project Officer?
faq.answer: The applicant must not be more than 62 years of age on the closing date, i.e. not retired more than 2 years back.

faq.question: Q5. How are retired employees paid for the CRIS Project Officer post?
faq.answer: Remuneration for the post-retirement assignment is as per CRIS norms; the notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for the CRIS Project Officer post?
faq.answer: Fill in the enclosed application format and send it with a copy of PPO/Service and Experience certificate by Dak or by email to [email protected] in PDF format.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure of the CRIS Project Officer engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement period is initially for one year.

faq.question: Q8. Does the CRIS Project Officer post involve shift and weekend duty?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that duty in shift is required and that holiday working, including Saturday and Sunday, is required.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be sent with the CRIS Project Officer application?
faq.answer: A copy of PPO/Service and Experience certificate must be sent with the application; the form specifically asks for a legible copy of the PPO.
